messages:
alex: Postmortem is up -> https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-03-vendor-outage. We listed follow-ups for vendor/dependency mitigations: model-registry auth fallbacks, cloud zone failover, and vendor escalation ownership. Need owners + timelines so we can close the postmortem loop.

priya: I can own the model-registry auth work. Will do initial investigation today, aim for a design doc by EOD Fri and a PR next week.

sam: I'll take the cloud provider zone failover and runbook updates. Plan: add automated region fallback config, test harness, and a playbook. Target 2 weeks for infra changes, tests earlier.

maria: I can own the vendor escalation/playbook and dependency ownership registry (contacts + SLAs). Will draft an ownership doc by Monday.

jordan: For auth provider flakiness we should implement a circuit breaker + exponential backoff + token-caching. Priya — want to pair on the design? Also add tracing for fallback paths.

priya: Yes please. Jordan, can we block 2 hours tomorrow morning to pair? I'm adding ticket INF-4580 for the auth circuit-breaker work.

ops-bot: Created tickets: INF-4580 (auth-circuit-breaker), INF-4581 (model-registry-retry-and-cache), INF-4582 (region-failover-runbook). Links: https://issues.redwood/INF-4580 https://issues.redwood/INF-4581 https://issues.redwood/INF-4582 :white_check_mark:

alex: Perfect. Also we should run recurring checks — we've seen an auth spike pattern (Wed afternoons) 3x last month. Can we add a monthly postmortem sanity check until metrics look stable?

sam: Will do. I'll schedule a weekly 15m reliability brief for the next 4 weeks and attach the dashboard showing auth error rate and region failover metrics. Adding notes to INF-4582.

priya: ```
- [ ] Implement circuit breaker (INF-4580)
- [ ] Add token caching + refresh metrics (INF-4581)
- [ ] Run simulated zone outage tests (INF-4582)
- [ ] Update runbook & escalation contacts
- [ ] Add alert for auth-error-rate > 5% for 5m
```

maria: :thumbsup: I'll own the runbook contact list and vendor SLA follow-up. Quick Q — do we want Legal looped into vendor escalation templates for enterprise customers?

alex: Yes, include Legal + account execs in the escalation matrix for any outage impacting enterprise SLAs. Maria, add that to the doc and ping Sales.

priya: Pairing tomorrow 10:00 AM PT. I already have a tiny test harness that simulates token failures; PR will include graceful fallback to cached model artifacts (read-only) while retry/backoff kicks in.

jordan: Also adding a tracing tag `fallback_reason` and `vendor_id` on requests that use fallback paths so we can query regressions easily.

alex: Ownership summary for follow-ups: Priya -> auth + model-registry retries (INF-4580/INF-4581), Sam -> region failover tests + runbook infra (INF-4582), Maria -> vendor SLA & escalation doc. I'll report progress in the all-hands on Friday. :eyes:

deploy-bot: Reminder: weekly reliability sync scheduled Thu 11:00 PT. INF-4580/INF-4581/INF-4582 added to the agenda.

alex: Thanks everyone — please update your INF tickets with PR links and estimated completion dates. We'll re-evaluate if the Wed pattern continues after two weeks.
